Beginner.learningGoal: Model values with data classes and use copy, destructuring and equality.
gotchas: copy is shallow, so mutable list properties remain shared
Only constructor properties participate in equals, hashCode and toString
goodSolutionShows: Data class with val properties and copy for updates
Equality tests based on structural equality
shapeHints: a Money or Point data class with copy and plus
using data classes as map keys

Intermediate.learningGoal: Model a closed set of cases with a sealed hierarchy and an exhaustive when expression.
gotchas: else in a when over a sealed type hides newly added subtypes
Sealed interface subtypes may be objects or classes; object comparison is by identity
when used as a statement is not forced to be exhaustive for non-sealed subjects
goodSolutionShows: when as an expression without else
data object or object for stateless cases
Sealed result type instead of exceptions or booleans
shapeHints: a UiState of Loading, Content and Error

Advanced.learningGoal: Use sealed hierarchies recursively, with generics, and pattern-like when with guards and smart casts.
gotchas: Generic sealed classes need variance (out T) to allow Nothing subtypes
Smart cast inside when requires the subject to be a stable val
when with multiple conditions per branch loses smart-cast precision
goodSolutionShows: sealed interface Result<out T> with map and flatMap
shapeHints: a typed Result with map and fold
a simplifier for an arithmetic expression tree
a command parser returning sealed commands
